components.name: Primary button
components.description: Sage action with visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .primary { font-family: "Geist Variable", sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:520; min-height:36px; padding:10px 13px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:7px; background:var(--mint, #b8e5a0); color:var(--mint-ink, #172311); cursor:pointer; transition:background .18s,color .18s,border-color .18s; } .primary:hover { background:#cbefb6; } .primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mint, #b8e5a0); outline-offset:4px; } .primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Field
components.css: .field { display:grid; gap:11px; font:12px "Geist Variable",sans-serif; color:var(--text,#e7eae7); } input { font:13px "Geist Variable",sans-serif; min-width:0; border:1px solid #373e36; border-radius:7px; background:var(--input,#141714); color:var(--text,#e7eae7); padding:10px 12px; caret-color:var(--mint,#b8e5a0); } input::placeholder { color:#899389; } input:focus { border-color:var(--mint,#b8e5a0); } input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mint,#b8e5a0); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Navigation row
components.description: Current-page state in the left rail.
components.css: nav button { width:100%; height:42px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#a6afa5; text-align:left; font:12px "Geist Variable",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .18s,color .18s; } nav button[aria-current] { background:#293326; color:#d0eac0; } nav button:hover { background:#252b24; color:#e1e9dc; } nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mint,#b8e5a0); outline-offset:4px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { nav button { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview: A restrained operational workspace with charcoal and olive surfaces, pale sage actions, and warm review signals. Dense supporting information surrounds readable task titles; state and evidence carry more visual weight than decoration. This is a record of the implemented code, not an approved image composition.
keyCharacteristics: Compact Geist typography and restrained sage emphasis.
Work, review, and machine capacity visible together.
Explicit state labels and keyboard access.
dos: Do keep primary actions sage, review attention warm, and ordinary surfaces quiet.
Do pair color with status text, preserve visible focus, and respect reduced motion.
Do keep preview, live, stale, empty, and unavailable states explicit.
Do use real run evidence and capacity data to establish hierarchy.
donts: Don't imply that a sample task changed live infrastructure.
Don't expose host reboot, snapshot, or shell actions without supporting APIs.
Don't replace dense supporting content with oversized decorative dashboard cards.
